title: Protection of refrigerant piping located inside buildings.
officialText:
All refrigerant piping and fittings installed at a height less
than 7 feet 3 inches (2210 mm) above the floor shall be concealed or otherwise protected from mechanical damage except at the
point of connection to terminal equipment.
